admission.justification: A broken link sends a reader to a page that does not exist; this offline check is the one guard that keeps the documentation navigable after every later change.

applicability: Every public document that a user reads: the root README, ROADMAP, CONTRIBUTING, SECURITY and CODE_OF_CONDUCT, the package description and every .md and .txt file under docs/.
conditions: The link is relative, or absolute and points at this repository.
The link's path exists in the tree at the documented candidate.
An anchor names a heading of its target page, in the form the renderer gives it.
exclusions: Links to other repositories or external sites, which are not tree paths.
An anchor on a non-document target, which the check does not judge.
statement: Every relative link, and every absolute link to this repository, in a public document names a path of the tree, and an anchor names a heading of its target.
